content.title: Monitor portfolio performance
content.description: An investment professional reviews the portfolio overview, compares portfolio performance against the benchmark, switches among defined time ranges, inspects hovered data points in a custom tooltip, and locks or clears a selected chart point while keeping summary-card values anchored to the dashboard summary rather than transient hover state.
content.summary: Review portfolio performance over selectable periods
content.value: Provides a fast view of portfolio value, return, and benchmark-relative performance across supported periods.
criteria: Time range options are 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD, 1Y, and ALL.
The default time range is 1M.
Exactly one time-range value is active, and changing it updates the performance chart data range, visible x-axis labels, and displayed period comparison.
The performance chart includes portfolio and benchmark lines, horizontal grid, axes, a custom tooltip, an active point indicator, and portfolio area fill; it must not use a default library tooltip.
Hovering updates the date, portfolio value, benchmark value, and return, but must not modify summary-card data.
Clicking a chart point locks selection, a second click unlocks it, Escape clears the lock, and changing time range clears the selected point.

content.title: Review holdings and inspect securities
content.description: An investment professional reviews the top holdings table with asset, pricing, position, weight, and P&L context, opens a preview popover from a ticker without reflowing the page, and drills into an in-page security modal for deeper pricing, fundamentals, analyst consensus, and news details.
content.summary: Inspect holdings and open detailed security views
content.value: Connects portfolio positions to security-level context without leaving the dashboard.
criteria: The top-holdings list contains AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, AMZN, GOOGL, META, JPM, and XOM.
Holdings columns are ASSET, PRICE, DAY, POSITION, WEIGHT, and P&L.
A security preview popover opens on hover or explicit ticker activation and shows ticker, company name, price, daily move, Market Cap, P/E, 52W range, and OPEN SECURITY.
The preview popover must not cause page reflow.
The security modal shows security name, ticker, price, daily move, chart, fundamentals, analyst consensus, and recent news.
The security modal closes by Escape, close button, or backdrop click, and clicking inside the modal body does not close it.

content.title: Monitor portfolio risk and concentration warnings
content.description: An investment professional reviews the portfolio’s risk metrics and gauge, sees whether overall risk is low, moderate, or high, and investigates an interactive concentration warning to understand current allocation, target, deviation, and the recommended follow-up action.
content.summary: Review portfolio risk status and investigate warnings
content.value: Surfaces portfolio risk exposure and highlights actionable concentration issues.
criteria: Risk metrics include Volatility, Sharpe, Beta, Max Drawdown, and VaR 95% with displayed values.
The risk gauge presents LOW, MODERATE, and HIGH states, with a current value of 61 and status MODERATE.
The dashboard shows an interactive warning when technology exposure exceeds target by 4.2%.
The warning popover shows Current allocation 31.7%, Target 27.5%, Deviation +4.2%, and the recommended action to review sector concentration.
The warning popover closes when clicking elsewhere or pressing Escape.

content.title: Analyze portfolio allocation
content.description: An investment professional reviews how the portfolio is distributed across asset classes, uses the donut chart and legend to compare percentages and values, and focuses on a selected allocation by hovering or locking a segment until the chart or time-range context changes.
content.value: Shows portfolio composition and helps the user focus on individual allocation slices.
criteria: Allocation slices are Equities 48%, Fixed Income 24%, Alternatives 13%, Cash 9%, and Commodities 6%.
The chart center shows $24.8M TOTAL and the legend shows asset class, percentage, and value.
Hovering a segment expands it by 4px, highlights the matching legend item, and replaces the center label with the selected allocation.
Clicking locks a segment, clicking the same segment again unlocks it, and changing chart or time-range context clears selection.

content.title: Review and expand portfolio alerts
content.description: An investment professional scans portfolio and market-relevant alerts by severity, expands a single alert inline to inspect more detail, and shifts focus between alerts without turning the list into a modal interaction or leaving more than one alert expanded at once.
content.summary: Review alert feed and expand one alert at a time
content.value: Keeps the user aware of urgent events and lets them inspect one actionable alert at a time.
criteria: The alerts panel includes Technology concentration above target, NVDA crossed 52-week high, Portfolio volatility increased 7.2%, Fed rate decision tomorrow, and Cash position below tactical minimum.
Alert severities are critical, warning, and info.
Each alert includes severity, title, timestamp, and a dismiss control where applicable.
Clicking an alert expands it inline, only one alert may be expanded at once, and opening another collapses the previous one.
The alert list must not become a modal.

content.title: Customize dashboard layout and chart display
content.description: An investment professional opens the customization drawer to change display density, show or hide major dashboard sections, and turn chart options on or off, with the expectation that the visible layout, benchmark line, grid, and hover indicators actually update and reflow in place.
content.summary: Adjust dashboard density, sections, and chart options
content.value: Lets the user tailor information density and visible workspace content without leaving the page.
criteria: Display density options are Compact, Comfortable, and Spacious, with Comfortable selected by default.
Visible-section toggles cover Portfolio Summary, Performance, Allocation, Holdings, Risk, Market Overview, Alerts, and Activity.
Chart options are Benchmark, Grid, and Hover Indicators.
Disabling a section removes that section and the surrounding layout reflows automatically.
Disabling Benchmark removes the benchmark line and related legend element, disabling Grid removes the chart grid, and disabling Hover Indicators removes active hover marker behavior.

content.title: Navigate dashboard contexts
content.description: An investment professional moves among the dashboard’s portfolio, analytics, research, and system contexts through the fixed sidebar, changes the active state and page heading without routing to another page or URL, and stays within the single-page terminal while contextual content updates in place.
content.summary: Switch dashboard context within the single-page workspace
content.value: Keeps navigation fast and contained while exposing all major dashboard areas from one shell.
criteria: Navigation stays within one page: there is no application routing, separate dashboard pages, URL navigation, or multi-page workflow.
Primary navigation items are Overview, Portfolio, Markets, Watchlist, and Transactions.
Analytics items are Performance, Risk, Attribution, and Scenarios.
Research items are Research Notes, Saved Views, and Reports.
System items are Alerts and Data Health.
Overview is selected by default, and clicking a sidebar item changes active state and contextual page heading without routing away.

content.title: Review market instruments
content.description: An investment professional watches a compact market overview for key instruments, compares current values and daily percentage changes, and uses deterministic sparklines and hover emphasis to inspect movement without disrupting row sizing or neighboring content.
content.value: Provides quick external market context alongside portfolio-specific information.
criteria: The market overview tracks S&P 500, NASDAQ, DOW, and BTC/USD.
Each market row includes instrument, value, daily percentage, and sparkline.
Sparklines use deterministic mock data.
Hovering emphasizes the row and subtly enlarges the sparkline region without changing row height or moving neighboring content.

content.title: Review recent portfolio activity
content.description: An investment professional reviews a recent-activity feed of portfolio events, scans timestamps, event types, assets, values, and statuses, and uses the table as a compact chronological record of trading, alerts, dividends, and rebalancing actions.
content.value: Shows the latest portfolio and system events in a single timeline-oriented table.
criteria: Recent activity columns are TIME, TYPE, DESCRIPTION, ASSET, VALUE, and STATUS.
Sample activity types include BUY, SELL, ALERT, DIVIDEND, and REBALANCE, with statuses including COMPLETED and OPEN.
Statuses are displayed as compact pills.

content.title: Search assets, metrics, and reports
content.description: An investment professional invokes the global search field from the header to begin finding assets, metrics, and reports, uses keyboard focus and shortcut behavior to access it quickly, and clears focus or the search overlay without destabilizing the field’s layout.
content.summary: Use global search from the header
content.value: Improves speed of access to portfolio and research context from anywhere in the terminal.
criteria: The global search field is labeled with the placeholder “Search assets, metrics, reports...”.
Focus changes the border to information blue and applies a subtle focus ring while keeping the search field visually stable.
Cmd/Ctrl + K focuses the search field and Escape clears focus or the search overlay.

content.title: Export portfolio views and reports
content.description: An investment professional opens the export popover, chooses which dashboard slice to export, selects a target format, and receives success feedback for the queued action even though the benchmark does not require a real file export implementation.
content.summary: Queue exports for views, holdings, transactions, or risk
content.value: Packages portfolio information into standard output types for downstream use without leaving the page.
criteria: Export actions are Export Current View, Export Holdings, Export Transactions, and Export Risk Report.
Export formats are CSV, JSON, and PDF.
CSV is the default export format.
Choosing an export action creates a fake success toast, and no real export is required.

content.title: Review profile information and options
content.description: An investment professional opens the avatar popover to confirm identity, role, workspace, and status, and accesses profile-related actions such as preferences, keyboard shortcuts, and sign-out without navigating away from the single-page dashboard.
content.summary: Open the profile popover and review user options
content.value: Provides lightweight account and workspace context plus access to user-oriented actions in place.
criteria: The profile popover displays the user name, role, workspace, and status.
Profile actions are Preferences, Keyboard shortcuts, and Sign out.
No profile action should navigate away from the page.
